quality.minimum_distinct_ratio_note: How much of the sentence is new rather than echoed. Probed against real harvested Portuguese: every degenerate line scored 0.67 or below ('O que? O que e que eu...' 0.57) and every natural one 0.83 or above, so the boundary sits in an empty gap. Drops 1,718 of 120,000 candidates.
quality.minimum_distinct_tokens_note: A sentence must show a word doing something. Easiness counts unfamiliar words and skips the target, so a line of pure repetition scores a perfect 0.0 and wins every ranking. Measured on 118,244 harvested Portuguese sentences: only 1.0% have four or fewer distinct tokens, so this removes the pathology at negligible cost to the pool.
quality.reject_truncated_fragments_note: A line cut mid-thought is grammatical and teaches nothing: the clause the target belongs to was never finished. Measured on the Portuguese pilot: 6.5% of candidates, and no card fell below the five it must display (lowest pool 48 of 60).
quality.fragment_note: A subtitle row is a slice of a stream: it can begin partway through one sentence and end partway through the next. A row starting lowercase is a continuation of the row before it, and one ending in a comma, semicolon or colon stops before its clause closes. Both read as broken language rather than as an example. Measured on the shipped decks: 3.4% and 0.7% of Czech displayed examples, 0.4% and 0.3% of Portuguese.

scan.note: Stop scanning once this fraction of cards has filled its WSD budget. Harvest time is linear in corpus size, but the cards are not: the median Czech card has 1,128 matches and fills its 60 within the first 5% of the corpus, while three cards never fill it at all -- 23, 36 and 43 matches in 7.55M lines. Waiting for every card therefore costs a full scan to serve a handful of rare words. Measured on Czech and Portuguese, which agree closely: 95% of cards are satisfied by 19% of the corpus (5.3x faster), 98% by 30%, 99% by 46%. Past 95% each further percent of cards costs disproportionately more scanning, so that is where this sits. Cards left short are declared, never silently thinned -- shortfall_policy governs what happens to them. Absent means scan everything.
